issue: customer_id is order-scoped: distinct customer_id vs distinct people (customer_unique_id)
handling: dim_customers is keyed on customer_unique_id; all customer metrics pinned to it in metrics.yml. Using customer_id would make the repeat rate 0%.

issue: Orders with status 'delivered' but no delivered_to_customer date
handling: is_delivered requires both status and date, so these 8 are excluded from delivery KPIs (still revenue orders).

issue: Orders NOT delivered but carrying a customer-delivery date (canceled after delivery)
handling: Status wins: not counted as delivered.

issue: Orders with no items at all (mostly unavailable / canceled)
handling: is_revenue_order = false; kept in fct_orders for cancellation-rate denominators.

issue: Orders with no payment row
handling: Kept; payment_total_brl null, excluded from the reconciliation test.

issue: Orders with no review
handling: Review metrics use reviewed orders only (documented caveat: survey non-response is not random).

issue: Orders with more than one review row
handling: int_reviews_latest_per_order keeps the latest answered review.

issue: review_id values shared by more than one order (review_id is not a key)
handling: Grain of stg_olist__reviews is (review_id, order_id) via review_key.

issue: Geolocation rows that are duplicates of (zip, lat, lng)
handling: int_zip_geolocation: one row per zip prefix (median lat/lng, modal city/state).

issue: Geolocation points outside Brazil's bounding box
handling: Dropped before taking the median coordinate.

issue: Zip prefixes mapped to more than one state in geolocation
handling: Modal state used.

issue: City spelling variants in geolocation (distinct raw names minus accent/case-normalised names)
handling: Cities normalised with lower(strip_accents(trim())) in staging.

issue: Customer zip prefixes with no geolocation match
handling: seller_customer_km is null for those orders; models treat missing distance as 0 km + the log feature (documented).

issue: Seller zip prefixes with no geolocation match
handling: Same as DQ13.

issue: Products with null category
handling: category = 'unknown'.

issue: Categories missing from the English translation file
handling: seeds/category_translation_patch.csv adds the 2 missing names.

issue: Products with weight 0 g
handling: Set to null (physically impossible).

issue: Source column names misspelled ('lenght')
handling: Renamed to *_length in stg_olist__products.

issue: Translation file header starts with a UTF-8 BOM
handling: Column renamed in ingest (marketplace.ingest).

issue: Orders handed to the carrier before they were purchased
handling: Kept (timestamps likely recorded in different time zones/systems); handling_days can be negative; analyses use medians.

issue: Orders delivered to the customer before the carrier pick-up
handling: Kept; carrier_transit_days can be negative; medians used.

issue: Orders delivered before purchase
handling: None found; enforced by dbt test assert_delivered_not_before_purchase.

issue: Orders where payments differ from item price + freight by > 1 BRL
handling: Mostly instalment interest (n>1 and overpaid) - allowed. Remaining exceptions WARN in dbt test assert_payments_reconcile_to_items (error only if >0.5% of orders).

issue: ...of which NOT explained by instalment interest
handling: Reported as dbt WARN; investigated in a real team.

issue: Payment rows with payment_type 'not_defined'
handling: Kept as a category (all have value 0).

issue: Payment rows with value 0
handling: Kept.

issue: Item lines with freight 0
handling: Kept (free shipping promotions).

issue: Purchase months with sparse capture: orders in Sep-Dec 2016 (Nov-2016 has none)
handling: Analyses use the reliable window Jan-2017..Aug-2018 (dim_date.is_in_reliable_window).

issue: Orders purchased after 2018-08-31 (feed tails off: Sep/Oct 2018)
handling: Excluded from analyses; the anomaly monitor flags the drop as a data-feed incident.

issue: People (customer_unique_id) with more than one delivery zip over time
handling: Modelled as SCD2 history in dim_customer_location_history.

issue: Orders with items from more than one seller
handling: Order-level seller = primary seller (largest price share); item-level facts keep every seller.

issue: Estimated delivery date stored as midnight timestamp (it is a date)
handling: 0 non-midnight values: cast to DATE; on-time compares dates (timestamp compare would mis-count same-day deliveries as late).

issue: Orders handed to the carrier before they were APPROVED (negative handling time)
handling: Kept; handling_days is negative for these. Stage analyses use medians; flagged as a source timestamp issue.

issue: Reviews of LATE delivered orders answered before the parcel arrived
handling: Survey fires ~2 days after the promised date. Review effects are reported for all reviews AND post-delivery reviews only (delivery_impact.json).

issue: Delivered revenue orders with no seller-customer distance (zip not geocoded)
handling: Models use a missing-distance indicator plus 0 km fill (no silent imputation).

issue: Revenue orders never delivered (shipped/processing/invoiced/approved/created)
handling: Counted as LATE in promise-policy evaluation; excluded from review regressions (no delivery date).
